status: Specified before this experiment; retrospective, all seasons previously studied
training: Tail feature for each historical season generated by a model fitted only to earlier seasons, with outcomes available before that season's first cutoff. Outer models use only older seasons and rows available before outer cutoff.
reason_start: 2019-20 warms up tail model; 2020-21 supplies first honest tail-feature training rows. Both matched main models drop 2019-20.
feature: One extra variable: expected Y*1(Y>=8) per fixture, clipped at zero. Same HGB architecture, full-point target, BASE+FX features.
blends: 50% frozen Ridge/Extra reference + 50% respective matched HGB
captain: On frozen reference squads/starters/bench/transfers, select highest tail score among starters within 0.5 expected points of the best starter. Stable ties: higher mean then lower pid. If captain changes, previous captain becomes vice. Opening unchanged.
primary: Net GW38 season points, paired with matched control and strong reference; two original chip regimes
secondary: Top20 8+ precision; cheap and short-history top10; captain delta with actual fallback and TC multiplier
filter: No separate hard pool filter in this experiment; feature and captain gate are evaluated first
selection: No post-result tuning, promotion only with evidence over matched and strong controls
limitations: Tail fixture contributions summed in DGW are not weekly haul probability
